A reference mark in the right margin (a small sign, not a note text). Fragments of the neighbouring page at far left edge, not transcribed.

main_text.p: melius, aurum videlicet Philosophorum nostrum, in quo inest spiritus tingens, de quo jam jam dicemus, si prius Tincturas Basilianas omnes percensuerimus.

Quintam igitur Basilius tincturam proponit in Jove & Saturno, sed tantùm ad coagulationem Mercurii, puta in argentum & aurum, per rubeum videlicet & dulce oleum eorum arte prolectum, uti Basilius non uno loco innuit. Hûc etiam pertinet, quod per commixtionem aliorum metallorum Paracelsus vexationû libro, de Saturno, Luna, & Mercurio componendis tradit. Hîc verò reticere non possum Basilium de Saturno & Jove vulgari loqui: sed si adhûc sint in suis mineris, altioris sunt indaginis ac virtutis; qua de re in curru trium-

page.notes: Catchword and signature: "B 4" at foot. The underlined words in the text are printed underlining. The sign in the right margin beside the text ("N" with a stroke) is a marginal mark, not transcribed as text. Some words at the line ends are hyphenated across lines (Basi-lius, tinctu-ram etc.) as printed. Left-edge fragments belong to the adjacent page and are not transcribed.
